explanation: The text answers the regime the coup began. It replaced the autocratic constitution of 1967 and closed twenty-one years of military dictatorship. It also changed what the state owes its citizens, with a long list of human and individual rights. That list reads as an inventory of what the twenty-one years had done. Read in this direction the edge says the constitution reacted to the coup, which is what its own drafters said they were doing.
